newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber futures mostly down after spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber futures mostly down after spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly weaker on Tuesday on moderate volume, after the spot March contract expired with a loss, traders said.
The March contract ended down 4.6 yen at 147.2 yen per kg at noon, with 917 lots delivered.
Other prices ranged from 1.6 yen lower to 0.3 yen up.

"The larger-than-expected deliveries helped the spot March contract expire at lower levels, which undermined market sentiment," one trader said. But prices recovered from early lows ahead of the close, helped by the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
